intro: The Signature Mira Peel is Skin Essence's flagship glow treatment, performed on the MiraPeel system at our Kalyani Nagar clinic. Despite the name, it is not a chemical peel. MiraPeel, short for Micro-Infusion Rolling Abrasion, is a skin transdermal delivery system designed in the European Union: a non-invasive, painless and bloodless way to resurface the skin gently and infuse concentrated serums into it, using six attachments in a single session.

The MIRAbrasor tip performs a controlled hydradermabrasion that lifts dead cells and tan with cool serum rather than abrasive crystals, and the MIRAextractor's gentle vacuum clears blackheads and congestion without squeezing. The MIRAroller, a micro-channelling tip with tightly placed micro-protrusions, then infuses the MIRAjolie serums deep into the skin: a salicylic acid and aloe exfoliator, a hyaluronic acid and panthenol moisturiser, a vitamin C and algae detoxifier, and a kojic acid, arbutin and vitamin A, C and E brightening complex. Microcurrent tones the facial muscles, cupping drains and relaxes, and red, green and blue LED light calms redness, helps acne-prone skin and supports collagen.

Dr. Daksha Patel, an MD dermatologist with 17+ years of experience, chooses the attachments and serums for each patient: calming and hydrating for dry or sensitive skin, clarifying for oily and acne-prone skin, brightening for tan and dullness. There is no downtime, which is why the Mira Peel is the first step of most glow plans and the treatment we recommend closest to a wedding or event.

howItWorks.title: Skin analysis

howItWorks.title: Resurface and extract
howItWorks.description: The MIRAbrasor lifts dead cells and tan with a flow of cool serum, then the MIRAextractor's vacuum clears blackheads and congestion painlessly.

howItWorks.title: Infuse and tone

aftercare: Sunscreen every morning; freshly resurfaced skin tans quickly without it.
Skip scrubs, retinoids and other actives for 3 days after the session.
No make-up for a few hours and no steam or sauna for 24 hours.
Keep water intake up; the infused serums work best in well-hydrated skin.

faqs.q: Is the Signature Mira Peel a chemical peel?
faqs.a: No. The name is the clinic's, but the treatment is performed on the MiraPeel system, which uses serum-based hydradermabrasion, vacuum extraction, micro-channelling serum infusion, microcurrent and LED rather than acids. It suits skin that cannot tolerate chemical peels.

faqs.q: Does it hurt, and is there downtime?
faqs.a: No. The system is non-invasive and bloodless; most patients describe cool suction and a light rolling sensation and find the session relaxing. There is no peeling, and the skin may look slightly pink for an hour or two.

faqs.q: How is it different from a HydraFacial?
faqs.a: The MIRAbrasor step is comparable to a HydraFacial. MiraPeel adds micro-channelling serum infusion, microcurrent, cupping and LED light in the same session, so more can be addressed in one visit.

faqs.q: How often should I have it?
faqs.a: One session gives an event glow that lasts a few weeks. For ongoing improvement in hydration, texture and congestion, most patients repeat it every 4 to 6 weeks.

faqs.q: Can I have it a few days before my wedding?
faqs.a: Yes. Because there is no downtime, the Mira Peel can be done 2 to 5 days before an event. For the best result, start monthly sessions 2 to 3 months ahead.
